20: ## Sunset City — open-world driving game with an AI social layer
21: 
22: A browser GTA-style sandbox (Three.js) where the city has residents: walk into a lit
23: doorway to join a chat room, talk to people on the street one-on-one, and pick up
24: contracts on the job board that AI crew members join and finish with you.
25: 
26: ### Run it
27: 
28: ```bash
29: npm install
30: npm run build          # bundle the client into dist/
31: npm start              # serves dist/ + the social hub API on PORT (default 3000)
32: ```
33: 
34: For development run the API and the Vite dev server in separate shells:
35: 
36: ```bash
37: PORT=3001 WEB_ROOT=dist npm run dev:api   # social hub API + SSE on :3001
38: npm run dev                               # game on :3000, /api proxied to :3001
39: ```
40: 
41: ### AI provider
42: 
43: | env | meaning |
44: | --- | --- |
45: | `ZEN_API_KEY` / `OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY` | OpenCode Zen key. When set, room replies come from a real model. |
46: | `ZEN_MODEL` | Model id, default `mimo-v2.6-flash-free`. |
47: | `PORT`, `WEB_ROOT` | API/static port (3000) and the built client folder (`dist`). |
48: 
49: Without a key the hub runs the built-in persona engine (`server/sim.js`): nine
50: residents with their own voices, room banter, and contract templates. `GET /api/health`
51: reports which provider is live (`zen` or `sim`). If a Zen call fails, the reply falls
52: back to the persona engine instead of erroring.
53: 
54: ### The social layer
55: 
56: - **7 walk-in venues** (El Rey Diner, Neon Net Cafe, Arcade '98, The Rusty Anchor,
57:   K-SUN Radio, Sunset Auto Garage, Vinyl & Velvet) with lit doorways, signs, and
58:   ground glows. Stand at a door and press `E` (or the DOOR button) to join.
59: - **9 residents** who talk in rooms, on the street one-on-one (`F` next to them), and
60:   in shared lobbies. Human players in other tabs are visible and talk back.
61: - **Job board** with contract templates: courier runs, rumour hunts, arcade
62:   tournaments, night drives, and favours. Steps mix room conversations (`ask`,
63:   `meet`, `report`, `pickup`), world drives, and collectibles, so different contracts
64:   play differently. Accept a contract and an AI companion joins and follows you.
65: - **Shared city state** over SSE: room messages, presence, and mission updates are
66:   broadcast to every client in the room.
67: 
68: ### API
69: 
70: `GET /api/health`, `GET /api/rooms`, `GET /api/room/:id`, `GET /api/personas`,
71: `GET /api/missions`, `GET /api/stream` (SSE), `POST /api/room/join`,
72: `POST /api/room/leave`, `POST /api/chat`, `POST /api/talk`,
73: `POST /api/missions/generate`, `POST /api/missions/accept`,
74: `POST /api/missions/progress`, `POST /api/missions/abandon`.
75: 
76: ### Layout
77: 
78: - `src/data/social.js` — shared residents, rooms, venue geometry, contract templates.
79: - `server/index.js` — static server, REST API, SSE hub, chat and contract lifecycle.
80: - `server/llm.js` — OpenCode Zen client. `server/sim.js` — offline persona engine.
81: - `src/social.js` — chat/DM/board UI, venue list, world speech bubbles.
82: - `src/main.js`, `src/world.js`, `src/entities.js`, `src/radar.js` — game, city, HUD.

93: const TOPIC_WORDS = ['crate', 'crates', 'van', 'call', 'caller', 'caller', 'midnight', 'favor', 'favour', 'score', 'cargo', 'manifest', 'package', 'job', 'money', 'town']

95: export function detectIntent(text, persona, room) {
96:   const t = (text || '').toLowerCase()
97:   if (/\b(bye|gtg|later|see ya|goodbye)\b/.test(t)) return 'farewell'
98:   if (/\b(hi|hello|hey|yo|sup|howdy|greetings)\b/.test(t)) return 'greeting'
99:   if (/\b(who are you|what do you do|introduce|your name)\b/.test(t)) return 'whoAreYou'
100:   if (/\b(job|work|mission|contract|board|hire|pay|cash|bounty)\b/.test(t)) return 'jobs'
101:   if (/\b(where|how do i (get|find)|directions)\b/.test(t)) return 'askWhere'
102:   if (/\b(help|what now|what should i)\b/.test(t)) return 'help'
103:   if (/\b(thanks|thank you|good work|appreciate|nice one|well played)\b/.test(t)) return 'compliment'
104:   if (/\b(stupid|idiot|useless|shut up)\b/.test(t)) return 'insult'
105:   if (/\b(tell me about|what about|any word on|heard about)\b/.test(t) || TOPIC_WORDS.some((w) => t.includes(w))) return 'askAbout'
106:   if (/\b(this place|what is this|where am i)\b/.test(t)) return 'askRoom'
107:   return 'default'
108: }

110: export function pick(list, seed = Math.random()) {
111:   return list[Math.floor(Math.abs(seed) * list.length) % list.length]
112: }

114: function fill(template, ctx) {
115:   return template
116:     .replace(/\{player\}/g, ctx.player || 'friend')
117:     .replace(/\{name\}/g, ctx.persona.name)
118:     .replace(/\{role\}/g, ctx.persona.role.toLowerCase())
119:     .replace(/\{room\}/g, ctx.room ? ctx.room.name : 'this place')
120:     .replace(/\{topic\}/g, ctx.topic || 'that')
121: }

123: export function simReply({ persona, room, text, history = [], player = 'friend', intel = null }) {
124:   const intent = detectIntent(text, persona, room)
125:   const seed = Math.random()
126:   let body = pick(BANK[intent] || BANK.default, seed)
127:   const topicMatch = (text || '').match(/\b(crates?|van|caller|midnight|favou?r|score|cargo|manifest|package)\b/i)
128:   const ctx = {
129:     persona,
130:     room,
131:     player,
132:     topic: topicMatch ? topicMatch[0].toLowerCase() : null
133:   }
134:   body = fill(body, ctx)
135: 
136:   const openerChance = 0.35 + (intent === 'greeting' ? 0.35 : 0)
137:   const opener = pick(OPENERS[persona.id] || ['Hey.'], seed + 0.13)
138:   const closer = pick(CLOSERS[persona.id] || ['See you around.'], seed + 0.37)
139: 
140:   const lastUser = [...history].reverse().find((m) => m.role === 'user')
141:   const remember = lastUser && history.length > 2 && Math.random() < 0.3
142:     ? ` You asked me about ${fill('{topic}', ctx) === 'that' ? 'that' : fill('{topic}', ctx)} earlier — same answer.`
143:     : ''
144: 
145:   const parts = []
146:   if (Math.random() < openerChance) parts.push(opener)
147:   parts.push(body)
148:   if (intel) parts.push(intel)
149:   if (remember) parts.push(remember.trim())
150:   if (Math.random() < 0.4) parts.push(closer)
151:   return parts.join(' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
152: }

182:   const finalSteps = steps.map((step) => ({ ...step }))
183:   const driveStep = finalSteps.find((s) => s.type === 'drive')
184:   if (driveStep && Math.random() < 0.6) {

192:     title: title || pick(TITLES[key] || ['Night Work'], Math.random()),
193:     brief: brief || 'Work came in off the street. Details are thin, but the pay is real.',
194:     steps: finalSteps,

227: export function createPalm(height = 6, lean = 0.22) {

229:   const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3([

232:     new THREE.Vector3(lean * 1.2, height * 0.7, 0.05),
233:     new THREE.Vector3(lean * 1.5, height, 0)
234:   ])
235:   const top = curve.getPoint(1)
236:   const trunkGeos = [new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 8, 0.22, 6, false)]
237:   for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
238:     trunkGeos.push(transformed(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.13, 7, 5), top.x + Math.cos(i * 2.1) * 0.2, top.y - 0.08, top.z + Math.sin(i * 2.1) * 0.2))
239:   }
240:   const trunk = mergedMesh(trunkGeos, new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x6e4d31, roughness: 1 }))
241:   group.add(trunk)

243:   const leafGeos = []
244:   for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
245:     const segs = 5
246:     const positions = []
247:     const indices = []
248:     const length = 2.3 + Math.random() * 1.1
249:     for (let s = 0; s <= segs; s++) {
250:       const t = s / segs
251:       const w = Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.22 + 0.02
252:       const droop = t * t * 1.15
253:       positions.push(-w, -droop, t * length, w, -droop, t * length)
254:       if (s < segs) {
255:         const a = s * 2
256:         indices.push(a, a + 1, a + 2, a + 1, a + 3, a + 2)
257:       }
258:     }
259:     const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
260:     geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
261:     geo.setIndex(indices)
262:     geo.computeVertexNormals()
263:     const angle = (i / 8) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.random() * 0.18
264:     transformed(geo, top.x, top.y, top.z, -0.15 + Math.random() * 0.32, angle, 0)

95: export function detectIntent(text, persona, room) {
96:   const t = (text || '').toLowerCase()
97:   if (/\b(bye|gtg|later|see ya|goodbye)\b/.test(t)) return 'farewell'
98:   if (/\b(hi|hello|hey|yo|sup|howdy|greetings)\b/.test(t)) return 'greeting'
99:   if (/\b(who are you|what do you do|introduce|your name)\b/.test(t)) return 'whoAreYou'
100:   if (/\b(job|work|mission|contract|board|hire|pay|cash|bounty)\b/.test(t)) return 'jobs'
101:   if (/\b(where|how do i (get|find)|directions)\b/.test(t)) return 'askWhere'
102:   if (/\b(help|what now|what should i)\b/.test(t)) return 'help'
103:   if (/\b(thanks|thank you|good work|appreciate|nice one|well played)\b/.test(t)) return 'compliment'
104:   if (/\b(stupid|idiot|useless|shut up)\b/.test(t)) return 'insult'
105:   if (/\b(tell me about|what about|any word on|heard about)\b/.test(t) || TOPIC_WORDS.some((w) => t.includes(w))) return 'askAbout'
106:   if (/\b(this place|what is this|where am i)\b/.test(t)) return 'askRoom'
107:   return 'default'
108: }

123: export function simReply({ persona, room, text, history = [], player = 'friend', intel = null }) {
124:   const intent = detectIntent(text, persona, room)
125:   const seed = Math.random()
126:   let body = pick(BANK[intent] || BANK.default, seed)
127:   const topicMatch = (text || '').match(/\b(crates?|van|caller|midnight|favou?r|score|cargo|manifest|package)\b/i)
128:   const ctx = {
129:     persona,
130:     room,
131:     player,
132:     topic: topicMatch ? topicMatch[0].toLowerCase() : null
133:   }
134:   body = fill(body, ctx)
135: 
136:   const openerChance = 0.35 + (intent === 'greeting' ? 0.35 : 0)
137:   const opener = pick(OPENERS[persona.id] || ['Hey.'], seed + 0.13)
138:   const closer = pick(CLOSERS[persona.id] || ['See you around.'], seed + 0.37)
139: 
140:   const lastUser = [...history].reverse().find((m) => m.role === 'user')
141:   const remember = lastUser && history.length > 2 && Math.random() < 0.3
142:     ? ` You asked me about ${fill('{topic}', ctx) === 'that' ? 'that' : fill('{topic}', ctx)} earlier — same answer.`
143:     : ''
144: 
145:   const parts = []
146:   if (Math.random() < openerChance) parts.push(opener)
147:   parts.push(body)
148:   if (intel) parts.push(intel)
149:   if (remember) parts.push(remember.trim())
150:   if (Math.random() < 0.4) parts.push(closer)
151:   return parts.join(' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
152: }

20: ## Sunset City — open-world driving game with an AI social layer
21: 
22: A browser GTA-style sandbox (Three.js) where the city has residents: walk into a lit
23: doorway to join a chat room, talk to people on the street one-on-one, and pick up
24: contracts on the job board that AI crew members join and finish with you.
25: 
26: ### Run it
27: 
28: ```bash
29: npm install
30: npm run build          # bundle the client into dist/
31: npm start              # serves dist/ + the social hub API on PORT (default 3000)
32: ```
33: 
34: For development run the API and the Vite dev server in separate shells:
35: 
36: ```bash
37: PORT=3001 WEB_ROOT=dist npm run dev:api   # social hub API + SSE on :3001
38: npm run dev                               # game on :3000, /api proxied to :3001
39: ```
40: 
41: ### AI provider
42: 
43: | env | meaning |
44: | --- | --- |
45: | `ZEN_API_KEY` / `OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY` | OpenCode Zen key. When set, room replies come from a real model. |
46: | `ZEN_MODEL` | Model id, default `mimo-v2.6-flash-free`. |
47: | `PORT`, `WEB_ROOT` | API/static port (3000) and the built client folder (`dist`). |
48: 
49: Without a key the hub runs the built-in persona engine (`server/sim.js`): nine
50: residents with their own voices, room banter, and contract templates. `GET /api/health`
51: reports which provider is live (`zen` or `sim`). If a Zen call fails, the reply falls
52: back to the persona engine instead of erroring.
53: 
54: ### The social layer
55: 
56: - **7 walk-in venues** (El Rey Diner, Neon Net Cafe, Arcade '98, The Rusty Anchor,
57:   K-SUN Radio, Sunset Auto Garage, Vinyl & Velvet) with lit doorways, signs, and
58:   ground glows. Stand at a door and press `E` (or the DOOR button) to join.
59: - **9 residents** who talk in rooms, on the street one-on-one (`F` next to them), and
60:   in shared lobbies. Human players in other tabs are visible and talk back.
61: - **Job board** with contract templates: courier runs, rumour hunts, arcade
62:   tournaments, night drives, and favours. Steps mix room conversations (`ask`,
63:   `meet`, `report`, `pickup`), world drives, and collectibles, so different contracts
64:   play differently. Accept a contract and an AI companion joins and follows you.
65: - **Shared city state** over SSE: room messages, presence, and mission updates are
66:   broadcast to every client in the room.
67: 
68: ### API
69: 
70: `GET /api/health`, `GET /api/rooms`, `GET /api/room/:id`, `GET /api/personas`,
71: `GET /api/missions`, `GET /api/stream` (SSE), `POST /api/room/join`,
72: `POST /api/room/leave`, `POST /api/chat`, `POST /api/talk`,
73: `POST /api/missions/generate`, `POST /api/missions/accept`,
74: `POST /api/missions/progress`, `POST /api/missions/abandon`.
75: 
76: ### Layout
77: 
78: - `src/data/social.js` — shared residents, rooms, venue geometry, contract templates.
79: - `server/index.js` — static server, REST API, SSE hub, chat and contract lifecycle.
80: - `server/llm.js` — OpenCode Zen client. `server/sim.js` — offline persona engine.
81: - `src/social.js` — chat/DM/board UI, venue list, world speech bubbles.

## Objective
- Update the existing game so AI characters interact with each other and players, and deliver a complete, playable game.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing game.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Identified the project as Sunset City, a Three.js open-world game with a social hub, NPCs, missions, and an offline persona engine.

### Active
- Implement and verify richer AI interactions in the existing game.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect how ambient NPC conversations and world interactions currently work.
2. Implement improvements that let AI characters interact naturally with each other and players.
3. Build and verify the playable game.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game loop, NPCs, and mission companions.
- `src/social.js`: Room and private-chat UI and interactions.
- `server/sim.js`: Offline AI persona replies and ambient dialogue.
- `server/index.js`: Social API, room messaging, and ambient conversation scheduling.
- `src/data/social.js`: NPC personas, venues, and mission templates.

## Important Context
- The game already has nine residents, chat rooms, one-on-one NPC chat, missions with AI companions, and offline persona-based dialogue.
- No files have been changed yet.

95: export function detectIntent(text, persona, room) {
96:   const t = (text || '').toLowerCase()
97:   if (/\b(bye|gtg|later|see ya|goodbye)\b/.test(t)) return 'farewell'
98:   if (/\b(hi|hello|hey|yo|sup|howdy|greetings)\b/.test(t)) return 'greeting'
99:   if (/\b(who are you|what do you do|introduce|your name)\b/.test(t)) return 'whoAreYou'
100:   if (/\b(job|work|mission|contract|board|hire|pay|cash|bounty)\b/.test(t)) return 'jobs'
101:   if (/\b(where|how do i (get|find)|directions)\b/.test(t)) return 'askWhere'
102:   if (/\b(help|what now|what should i)\b/.test(t)) return 'help'
103:   if (/\b(thanks|thank you|good work|appreciate|nice one|well played)\b/.test(t)) return 'compliment'
104:   if (/\b(stupid|idiot|useless|shut up)\b/.test(t)) return 'insult'
105:   if (/\b(tell me about|what about|any word on|heard about)\b/.test(t) || TOPIC_WORDS.some((w) => t.includes(w))) return 'askAbout'
106:   if (/\b(this place|what is this|where am i)\b/.test(t)) return 'askRoom'
107:   return 'default'
108: }

110: export function pick(list, seed = Math.random()) {
111:   return list[Math.floor(Math.abs(seed) * list.length) % list.length]

114: function fill(template, ctx) {
115:   return template
116:     .replace(/\{player\}/g, ctx.player || 'friend')
117:     .replace(/\{name\}/g, ctx.persona.name)
118:     .replace(/\{role\}/g, ctx.persona.role.toLowerCase())
119:     .replace(/\{room\}/g, ctx.room ? ctx.room.name : 'this place')
120:     .replace(/\{topic\}/g, ctx.topic || 'that')
121: }

123: export function simReply({ persona, room, text, history = [], player = 'friend', intel = null }) {
124:   const intent = detectIntent(text, persona, room)
125:   const seed = Math.random()
126:   let body = pick(BANK[intent] || BANK.default, seed)
127:   const topicMatch = (text || '').match(/\b(crates?|van|caller|midnight|favou?r|score|cargo|manifest|package)\b/i)
128:   const ctx = {
129:     persona,
130:     room,
131:     player,
132:     topic: topicMatch ? topicMatch[0].toLowerCase() : null
133:   }
134:   body = fill(body, ctx)
135: 
136:   const openerChance = 0.35 + (intent === 'greeting' ? 0.35 : 0)
137:   const opener = pick(OPENERS[persona.id] || ['Hey.'], seed + 0.13)
138:   const closer = pick(CLOSERS[persona.id] || ['See you around.'], seed + 0.37)
139: 
140:   const lastUser = [...history].reverse().find((m) => m.role === 'user')
141:   const remember = lastUser && history.length > 2 && Math.random() < 0.3
142:     ? ` You asked me about ${fill('{topic}', ctx) === 'that' ? 'that' : fill('{topic}', ctx)} earlier — same answer.`
143:     : ''
144: 
145:   const parts = []
146:   if (Math.random() < openerChance) parts.push(opener)
147:   parts.push(body)
148:   if (intel) parts.push(intel)
149:   if (remember) parts.push(remember.trim())
150:   if (Math.random() < 0.4) parts.push(closer)
151:   return parts.join(' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
152: }

154: export function simAmbient({ room, personas }) {

157:   const b = personas.find((p) => p.id !== a.id)

180: export function simMission({ key, title, brief, steps, reward, giverId, companionIds }) {
181:   const spot = DISTRICT_SPOTS[Math.floor(Math.random() * DISTRICT_SPOTS.length)]
182:   const finalSteps = steps.map((step) => ({ ...step }))
183:   const driveStep = finalSteps.find((s) => s.type === 'drive')
184:   if (driveStep && Math.random() < 0.6) {
185:     driveStep.x = spot.x
186:     driveStep.z = spot.z
187:     driveStep.place = spot.name
188:   }
189:   return {
190:     id: `m-${key}-${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
191:     key,
192:     title: title || pick(TITLES[key] || ['Night Work'], Math.random()),
193:     brief: brief || 'Work came in off the street. Details are thin, but the pay is real.',
194:     steps: finalSteps,
195:     reward: reward + Math.floor(Math.random() * 600),
196:     giver: giverId,
197:     companions: companionIds,
198:     aiGenerated: false,
199:     createdAt: Date.now()
200:   }
201: }

203: export function simMissionBoard() {
204:   const picks = ['courier-run', 'rumour-hunt', 'tournament', 'night-drive', 'fixer-favor']
205:   const board = []
206:   for (const key of picks) {
207:     const template = MISSION_TEMPLATES.find((t) => t.key === key)
208:     if (!template) continue
209:     const giverId = template.giver || 'ivy'
210:     const companionPool = PERSONAS.map((p) => p.id).filter((id) => id !== giverId)
211:     const companion = companionPool[Math.floor(Math.random() * companionPool.length)]
212:     board.push(simMission({

214:       title: template.title,
215:       brief: template.brief,
216:       steps: template.steps,
217:       reward: template.reward,
218:       giverId,
219:       companionIds: [companion]
220:     }))
221:   }
222:   return board
223: }

## Objective
- Improve AI character interactions with each other and players in the existing Sunset City game, then build and verify a complete, playable game.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing game.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Identified Sunset City as a Three.js open-world game with a social hub, NPCs, missions, and an offline persona engine.
- Inspected the current ambient dialogue, chat, NPC, and companion behavior.

### Active
- Implement richer AI interactions and verify the playable game.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement more natural NPC-to-NPC and NPC-to-player interactions in the existing systems.
2. Build the game and verify it runs and is playable.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game loop, NPC interactions, and mission companions.
- `src/social.js`: Room and private-chat UI and interactions.
- `server/sim.js`: Offline persona replies and ambient dialogue.
- `server/index.js`: Social API, room messaging, and ambient conversation scheduling.
- `src/data/social.js`: NPC personas, venues, and mission templates.

## Important Context
- The game has nine residents, chat rooms, one-on-one NPC chat, missions with AI companions, and offline persona-based dialogue.
- No files have been changed.
- Offline ambient dialogue can produce a two-NPC exchange; when the LLM is available, `generateAmbient()` instead returns one line from the first room member. Ambient dialogue runs every 75 seconds only while a room has people.

95: export function detectIntent(text, persona, room) {
96:   const t = (text || '').toLowerCase()
97:   if (/\b(bye|gtg|later|see ya|goodbye)\b/.test(t)) return 'farewell'
98:   if (/\b(hi|hello|hey|yo|sup|howdy|greetings)\b/.test(t)) return 'greeting'
99:   if (/\b(who are you|what do you do|introduce|your name)\b/.test(t)) return 'whoAreYou'
100:   if (/\b(job|work|mission|contract|board|hire|pay|cash|bounty)\b/.test(t)) return 'jobs'
101:   if (/\b(where|how do i (get|find)|directions)\b/.test(t)) return 'askWhere'
102:   if (/\b(help|what now|what should i)\b/.test(t)) return 'help'
103:   if (/\b(thanks|thank you|good work|appreciate|nice one|well played)\b/.test(t)) return 'compliment'
104:   if (/\b(stupid|idiot|useless|shut up)\b/.test(t)) return 'insult'
105:   if (/\b(tell me about|what about|any word on|heard about)\b/.test(t) || TOPIC_WORDS.some((w) => t.includes(w))) return 'askAbout'
106:   if (/\b(this place|what is this|where am i)\b/.test(t)) return 'askRoom'
107:   return 'default'
108: }

110: export function pick(list, seed = Math.random()) {
111:   return list[Math.floor(Math.abs(seed) * list.length) % list.length]
112: }

114: function fill(template, ctx) {
115:   return template
116:     .replace(/\{player\}/g, ctx.player || 'friend')
117:     .replace(/\{name\}/g, ctx.persona.name)
118:     .replace(/\{role\}/g, ctx.persona.role.toLowerCase())
119:     .replace(/\{room\}/g, ctx.room ? ctx.room.name : 'this place')
120:     .replace(/\{topic\}/g, ctx.topic || 'that')
121: }

123: export function simReply({ persona, room, text, history = [], player = 'friend', intel = null }) {
124:   const intent = detectIntent(text, persona, room)
125:   const seed = Math.random()
126:   let body = pick(BANK[intent] || BANK.default, seed)
127:   const topicMatch = (text || '').match(/\b(crates?|van|caller|midnight|favou?r|score|cargo|manifest|package)\b/i)
128:   const ctx = {
129:     persona,
130:     room,
131:     player,
132:     topic: topicMatch ? topicMatch[0].toLowerCase() : null
133:   }
134:   body = fill(body, ctx)
135: 
136:   const openerChance = 0.35 + (intent === 'greeting' ? 0.35 : 0)
137:   const opener = pick(OPENERS[persona.id] || ['Hey.'], seed + 0.13)
138:   const closer = pick(CLOSERS[persona.id] || ['See you around.'], seed + 0.37)
139: 
140:   const lastUser = [...history].reverse().find((m) => m.role === 'user')
141:   const remember = lastUser && history.length > 2 && Math.random() < 0.3
142:     ? ` You asked me about ${fill('{topic}', ctx) === 'that' ? 'that' : fill('{topic}', ctx)} earlier — same answer.`
143:     : ''
144: 
145:   const parts = []
146:   if (Math.random() < openerChance) parts.push(opener)
147:   parts.push(body)
148:   if (intel) parts.push(intel)
149:   if (remember) parts.push(remember.trim())
150:   if (Math.random() < 0.4) parts.push(closer)
151:   return parts.join(' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
152: }

154: export function simAmbient({ room, personas }) {
155:   if (!personas.length) return []
156:   const a = personas[Math.floor(Math.random() * personas.length)]
157:   const b = personas.find((p) => p.id !== a.id)
158:   if (!b) return [{ personaId: a.id, text: `${a.name} is nursing a drink and watching the door.` }]
159:   const lines = [
160:     [`${a.name}: "You ever get the feeling the whole city is one beat behind?"`, `${b.name}: "Only on nights when it is not."`],
161:     [`${a.name}: "Board is slow tonight."`, `${b.name}: "Boards are always slow. That is why you talk to people."`],
162:     [`${a.name}: "Sunset hit the water all orange just now."`, `${b.name}: "Take a picture then, do not just describe it."`],
163:     [`${a.name}: "Somebody left a package at the garage again."`, `${b.name}: "Somebody always leaves a package. That is the job."`]
164:   ]
165:   const pair = pick(lines, Math.random())
166:   return [
167:     { personaId: a.id, text: pair[0].replace(`${a.name}: `, '') },
168:     { personaId: b.id, text: pair[1].replace(`${b.name}: `, '') }
169:   ]
170: }

182:   const finalSteps = steps.map((step) => ({ ...step }))
183:   const driveStep = finalSteps.find((s) => s.type === 'drive')
184:   if (driveStep && Math.random() < 0.6) {

186:     driveStep.z = spot.z
187:     driveStep.place = spot.name

190:     id: `m-${key}-${Date.now().toString(36)}`,

193:     brief: brief || 'Work came in off the street. Details are thin, but the pay is real.',

212:     board.push(simMission({

215:       brief: template.brief,
216:       steps: template.steps,
217:       reward: template.reward,
218:       giverId,
219:       companionIds: [companion]
220:     }))
221:   }
222:   return board

20: ## Sunset City — open-world driving game with an AI social layer
21: 
22: A browser GTA-style sandbox (Three.js) where the city has residents: walk into a lit
23: doorway to join a chat room, talk to people on the street one-on-one, and pick up
24: contracts on the job board that AI crew members join and finish with you.
25: 
26: ### Run it
27: 
28: ```bash
29: npm install
30: npm run build          # bundle the client into dist/
31: npm start              # serves dist/ + the social hub API on PORT (default 3000)
32: ```
33: 
34: For development run the API and the Vite dev server in separate shells:
35: 
36: ```bash
37: PORT=3001 WEB_ROOT=dist npm run dev:api   # social hub API + SSE on :3001
38: npm run dev                               # game on :3000, /api proxied to :3001
39: ```
40: 
41: ### AI provider
42: 
43: | env | meaning |
44: | --- | --- |
45: | `ZEN_API_KEY` / `OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY` | OpenCode Zen key. When set, room replies come from a real model. |
46: | `ZEN_MODEL` | Model id, default `mimo-v2.6-flash-free`. |
47: | `PORT`, `WEB_ROOT` | API/static port (3000) and the built client folder (`dist`). |
48: 
49: Without a key the hub runs the built-in persona engine (`server/sim.js`): nine
50: residents with their own voices, room banter, and contract templates. `GET /api/health`
51: reports which provider is live (`zen` or `sim`). If a Zen call fails, the reply falls
52: back to the persona engine instead of erroring.
53: 
54: ### The social layer
55: 
56: - **7 walk-in venues** (El Rey Diner, Neon Net Cafe, Arcade '98, The Rusty Anchor,
57:   K-SUN Radio, Sunset Auto Garage, Vinyl & Velvet) with lit doorways, signs, and
58:   ground glows. Stand at a door and press `E` (or the DOOR button) to join.
59: - **9 residents** who talk in rooms, on the street one-on-one (`F` next to them), and
60:   in shared lobbies. Human players in other tabs are visible and talk back.
61: - **Job board** with contract templates: courier runs, rumour hunts, arcade
62:   tournaments, night drives, and favours. Steps mix room conversations (`ask`,
63:   `meet`, `report`, `pickup`), world drives, and collectibles, so different contracts
64:   play differently. Accept a contract and an AI companion joins and follows you.
65: - **Shared city state** over SSE: room messages, presence, and mission updates are
66:   broadcast to every client in the room.
67: 
68: ### API
69: 
70: `GET /api/health`, `GET /api/rooms`, `GET /api/room/:id`, `GET /api/personas`,
71: `GET /api/missions`, `GET /api/stream` (SSE), `POST /api/room/join`,
72: `POST /api/room/leave`, `POST /api/chat`, `POST /api/talk`,
73: `POST /api/missions/generate`, `POST /api/missions/accept`,
74: `POST /api/missions/progress`, `POST /api/missions/abandon`.
75: 
76: ### Layout
77: 
78: - `src/data/social.js` — shared residents, rooms, venue geometry, contract templates.
79: - `server/index.js` — static server, REST API, SSE hub, chat and contract lifecycle.
80: - `server/llm.js` — OpenCode Zen client. `server/sim.js` — offline persona engine.
81: - `src/social.js` — chat/DM/board UI, venue list, world speech bubbles.
82: - `src/main.js`, `src/world.js`, `src/entities.js`, `src/radar.js` — game, city, HUD.

1: // OpenCode Zen chat completions client. Used when a key is configured; the game falls
2: // back to the offline persona engine (server/sim.js) whenever this is unavailable.
3: 
4: const ZEN_BASE = process.env.ZEN_BASE_URL || 'https://opencode.ai/zen/v1'
5: const ZEN_KEY = process.env.ZEN_API_KEY || process.env.OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY || ''
6: export const ZEN_MODEL = process.env.ZEN_MODEL || 'mimo-v2.6-flash-free'
7: 
8: let cachedModels = null
9: let modelCheckedAt = 0
10: 
11: export function providerStatus() {
12:   return {
13:     provider: ZEN_KEY ? 'zen' : 'sim',
14:     model: ZEN_KEY ? ZEN_MODEL : 'sunset-sim',
15:     keyPresent: Boolean(ZEN_KEY)
16:   }
17: }
18: 
19: async function listModels() {
20:   if (cachedModels && Date.now() - modelCheckedAt < 10 * 60 * 1000) return cachedModels
21:   const res = await fetch(`${ZEN_BASE}/models`, {
22:     headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${ZEN_KEY || 'public'}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
23:   })
24:   if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`models ${res.status}`)
25:   const body = await res.json()
26:   cachedModels = (body.data || []).map((m) => m.id)
27:   modelCheckedAt = Date.now()
28:   return cachedModels
29: }
30: 
31: export async function complete({ system, messages, model = ZEN_MODEL, temperature = 0.9, maxTokens = 220 }) {
32:   if (!ZEN_KEY) throw new Error('no-zen-key')
33:   let target = model
34:   try {
35:     const models = await listModels()
36:     if (models.length && !models.includes(target)) {
37:       const free = models.find((id) => id.endsWith('-free'))
38:       target = free || models[0]
39:     }
40:   } catch {
41:     // model list unavailable, try the configured model anyway
42:   }
43: 
44:   const res = await fetch(`${ZEN_BASE}/chat/completions`, {
45:     method: 'POST',
46:     headers: {
47:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
48:       Authorization: `Bearer ${ZEN_KEY}`,
49:       'User-Agent': 'sunset-city/1.0'
50:     },
51:     body: JSON.stringify({
52:       model: target,
53:       temperature,
54:       max_tokens: maxTokens,
55:       stream: false,
56:       messages: [{ role: 'system', content: system }, ...messages]
57:     }),
58:     signal: AbortSignal.timeout(25000)
59:   })
60: 
61:   if (!res.ok) {
62:     const text = await res.text().catch(() => '')
63:     throw new Error(`zen ${res.status} ${text.slice(0, 200)}`)
64:   }
65:   const body = await res.json()
66:   const content = body?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content
67:   if (typeof content !== 'string' || !content.trim()) throw new Error('zen empty response')
68:   return { text: clean(content), model: target }
69: }
70: 
71: export function clean(text) {
72:   let out = String(text)
73:     .replace(/```[\s\S]*?```/g, '')
74:     .replace(/^\s*(?:assistant|nova|reply)\s*:\s*/i, '')
75:     .replace(/^["'`\u201c]+/, '')
76:     .replace(/["'`\u201d]+$/, '')
77:     .replace(/\*\*/g, '')
78:     .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
79:     .trim()
80:   if (out.length > 420) out = out.slice(0, 417).replace(/\s+\S*$/, '') + '...'
81:   return out
82: }

## Objective
- Improve AI character interactions with each other and players in the existing Sunset City game, then build and verify a complete, playable game.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing game.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Identified Sunset City as a Three.js open-world game with a social hub, nine residents, chat rooms, missions, and an offline persona engine.
- Inspected the ambient dialogue, chat, NPC, companion, and LLM integration code.

### Active
- Implement richer, more natural NPC-to-NPC and NPC-to-player interactions in the existing systems.
- Build the game and verify it runs and is playable.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Improve dialogue context and persona-specific responses, including ambient NPC-to-NPC exchanges.
2. Build the game and run available checks or gameplay verification.

## Relevant Files
- `server/sim.js`: Offline persona replies and ambient dialogue.
- `server/index.js`: Chat history, social API, room messaging, and ambient conversation scheduling.
- `src/data/social.js`: NPC personas, venues, and mission templates.
- `src/social.js`: Room and private-chat UI.
- `src/main.js`: Game loop, NPC interactions, and mission companions.
- `server/llm.js`: Optional OpenCode Zen completions and fallback behavior.
- `package.json`: Build and run scripts.

## Important Context
- No files have been changed.
- Offline `simAmbient()` currently returns a two-NPC exchange; when the LLM is available, `generateAmbient()` returns only one line from the first room member.
- Ambient dialogue runs every 75 seconds only while a room has people.
- `historyFor()` currently combines recent room chat into one user message rather than preserving individual speaker roles.

## Objective
- Improve AI character interactions with each other and players in the existing Sunset City game, then build and verify a complete, playable game.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing game.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Improve conversation history by preserving speaker attribution and giving each NPC relevant context.
- Make ambient NPC conversations multi-speaker exchanges with an offline fallback.

## Work State
### Completed
- Identified the existing Three.js game, social systems, offline persona engine, and optional LLM integration.
- Began adding persona-specific reactions and role-based ambient dialogue starters in `server/sim.js`.

### Active
- Improve player replies and NPC-to-NPC ambient exchanges across the offline and LLM paths.
- Build the game and run available checks or gameplay verification.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Finish persona-aware replies and ambient dialogue generation in `server/sim.js` and `server/index.js`.
2. Preserve individual speaker attribution in chat history and provide recent conversation context to NPCs.
3. Build the game and verify it runs and is playable.

## Relevant Files
- `server/sim.js`: Offline persona replies and ambient conversation; recently edited with persona reaction and ambient starter data.
- `server/index.js`: Chat history, reply generation, and ambient conversation scheduling.
- `server/llm.js`: Optional OpenCode Zen completions and fallback integration.
- `src/data/social.js`: NPC personas, venues, and mission templates.
- `src/social.js`: Room and private-chat UI.
- `package.json`: Build and run scripts.

## Important Context
- `simAmbient()` currently returns a two-NPC exchange, while the LLM ambient path returns only one line from the first room member.
- Ambient dialogue runs every 75 seconds only while a room has people.
- `historyFor()` currently combines recent room chat into one user message rather than preserving individual speaker roles.
- Changes are uncommitted; build and gameplay checks have not been run.

## Objective
- Improve AI character interactions with each other and players in the existing Sunset City game, then build and verify a complete, playable game.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing game.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Preserve speaker attribution and recent chat context for NPC replies.
- Make ambient NPC conversations multi-speaker exchanges with an offline fallback.
- Use role-aware offline dialogue and validate generated ambient speakers against room members.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added role-specific offline dialogue starters and character reactions in `server/sim.js`.
- Changed room history to preserve each speaker’s role and message instead of merging messages into one prompt.
- Added two-speaker LLM ambient exchanges with JSON parsing and offline fallback in `server/index.js`.

### Active
- Validate the new dialogue paths, build the game, and verify it runs and is playable.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run syntax checks and `npm run build`; fix any failures.
2. Exercise chat, NPC ambient exchanges, and fallback behavior through available server/API checks.
3. Report the implementation, verification results, and any assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `server/sim.js`: Offline persona replies and two-person ambient exchanges.
- `server/index.js`: Conversation history, LLM reply/ambient generation, server endpoints, and ambient schedule.
- `server/llm.js`: Optional OpenCode Zen completions and fallback integration.
- `src/data/social.js`: NPC personas, roles, rooms, and mission templates.
- `package.json`: Build and run scripts.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git diff --check` passed, but build and gameplay checks have not been run.
- Ambient dialogue is scheduled every 75 seconds only while a room has people.
